lessons.story:
WOODCRAFT WORKSHOP: A two-hour session costs one hundred and twenty dollars, including wood and basic tools. Each participant also leaves a fifty-dollar tool deposit at check-in. The deposit is returned when all borrowed tools are checked back in at the end of the session.

Participants must be at least fourteen and wear closed shoes. Students younger than sixteen need a parent to sign the registration form, but the parent does not have to join the workshop. The instructor will demonstrate tool use before anyone starts cutting.

Book online by Wednesday. Payment for the session is due at booking, while the deposit is paid in cash on arrival. Cancellations before Wednesday evening receive the session fee back. Later cancellations do not receive a refund, although the participant may request another date if a place is available.

Bring a bag to carry your finished work home. The workshop keeps unfinished pieces for seven days only. After that period, staff may reuse the wood. Taking a tool home by mistake delays the deposit return until the missing tool comes back.
lessons.title: The Workshop Deposit
